risk_semantics:
== Risk semantics (important) ==
- Weak risk (negative evidence from an uncalibrated context, 'weak reference'): the operator is downgraded below UNKNOWN candidates, but this is NOT a global prohibition. After UNKNOWN candidates have been exhausted and Support budget remains, one bounded probe of a weak-risk operator is allowed — the probe itself is the confirmation.
- Strong risk (context-matched or target-local negative evidence): avoid or abstain — do not probe.
